title: Fixed-G1 into G2 at 125.7598: the corrected class-match retention event (measured, not multiplied), traps counted on joint states (pattern multiplicities withdrawn), report cap with slack, one aux total

claims.statement: For the fixed nonidentity P in BLS12-381 G1 supplied by the challenge and uniform z in the order-r subgroup of GT (identity included), the disclosed classical algorithm returns Q in G2 with the pinned reduced pairing e(P,Q)=z for that exact supplied P with probability at least 0.39, and its complete classical work is at most 2^125.7598 dense-Fp12-multiplication equivalents at the protected C=20000, summed over all processors with no amortisation; the auxiliary work 2^56.499 is included in that total, not amortised against it (2^125.7598 + 2^56.499 rounds to the same four-decimal log2). The algorithm solves a = log_g z in GT with g = e(P,Q0) on the twelve-element Frobenius classes, N = (r-1)/12 = 2^251.27 classes, ord_r(p) = 12. One step computes the twelve class keys of the state y: min{keys12(y)} is the sigma-invariant class key used by the distinguished-point predicate and by the table row index, and the index of that minimum is kappa. Then either y is squared with the labels doubled (three of every eight classes) or y is multiplied by the pre-expanded entry TBL[t][col] = sigma^{-col}(M_t) = g^{u_t p^{-col}} with the first label increased by U[t][col] = u_t p^{-col} mod r (five of every eight), where col equals kappa unless row t occurred among the last D=12 multiply steps of this trail, in which case the column recorded then is reused. r-1 is factored exactly in factor_r.py and the product is re-multiplied and asserted: r-1 = 2^32*3*11*19*10177*125527*859267*906349^2*2508409*2529403*52437899*254760293^2, 255 bits, twelve distinct prime factors, each prime by Miller-Rabin over twelve bases; ord_r(p) = 12 follows from p^12 = 1 with p^6 != 1 and p^4 != 1; p^6 mod r = r-1 is checked, h = p^6 is not 1 and h^2 = 1, so an order-2 element exists, equals r-1 and is unique in F_r^*; ord_r(2) has 251 bits, so 2^s != 1 throughout the walk. RETENTION, CORRECTED AND MEASURED (v15 DEFECT 1). The v15 predicate is WITHDRAWN: it accepted a first meeting of the JOINT state (element, ring tuple) anywhere in 1..2D, never inside D, and every one of its counted events sat at lags 13..24. The event the collision solve actually consumes is a CLASS match: two records with equal class key k solve by x = (p^j a1 - a2)/(b2 - p^j b1) for j = 0..11, each candidate VERIFIED against z, so a wrong shift never yields a wrong answer. The class key min{keys12(y)} is a function of the ELEMENT ALONE; the ring does not enter it, so a class match is usable at the report instant and cannot be destroyed by a later guard rewrite. The retention factor on that event is exactly 1 and is NOT carried: the v15 debit 0.9809578 is removed, and the step budget is set to the same success target 0.392 that v15 reached AFTER the debit, so removing it lowers the work rather than raising the success claim. What the ring can destroy is path-sharing after a merge, which changes only the RATE of later matches; it is measured, not asserted: two trails starting on the same class with independent rings of the same depth keep identical class keys k steps after the merge at rates 0.9667 (k=1) and 0.7833 (k=12) at R=1024, D=12, versus 0.9750/0.3667 at D=24, 0.9250/0.0417 at D=48 and 0.7833/0.0083 at D=128 (160/120 pairs per depth, CP-95 lower bounds shipped), so shadowing lasts tens of steps against a 2^80-step report interval, i.e. below 2^-74 of the walk, inside the carried 10 per cent walk-quality allowance. Independent starts match classes at 0.0833 of pairs within 256 steps at R=1024 (20/240), the birthday event the success model counts. TRAP, COUNTED ON JOINT STATES (v15 DEFECT 2). The v15 pattern union bound is WITHDRAWN, not repaired: enumerating every word of length 4 and 6 over a five-letter alphabet and grouping by row-multiset class shows the multiplicative factor the v15 count omitted is 8.9 at L=4 and 74.4 at L=6 (465 times the C(L,L/2)/R^{L/2} it charged), and multiplicities restore the whole word space exactly, so no pattern-count route can bound a cycle. The step is instead a deterministic function of the augmented state (element, ring tuple), so an absorbing cycle IS a repeat of an augmented state, and the union bound over the S step pairs of one walk is tau <= S^2/(2 (r-1) (12R)^D) = 2^-215.26 at R = 2^14, D = 12 (state space 2^465.9), under the same ideal-table hypothesis the package discloses elsewhere; no pattern is enumerated, no theta is extrapolated and no 1/(12R) factor is multiplied, so the multiplicity defect cannot arise. The bound is 164 bits stronger than v15's withdrawn 2^-50.7 and is monotone in D (2^-426.3 at D=24, 2^-848.3 at D=48): D=12 is KEPT because it also has the best measured class-stream survival and the cheapest guard (48 instructions per multiply step; D=24 costs 84). The measured joint-state census rows are unchanged and reported beside it. The class marginal is measured and NOT uniform at fixture scale (chi-square 238889.4 on 526 df, p-value 0, worst cell 6.57 times the mean, 527 of 785 cells; chi-square over df 27.1, 71.8, 454.7 at S/sqrt(N) 0.71, 1.79, 7.14); the measured second moment is sum_c p_c^2 = 1/N_eff = 0.004708 against 1/N = 0.001274. The v15 sum-of-squares inference is DROPPED, not repaired: no Poisson lower bound and no collision-of-collisions step is used anywhere, the credit is not taken, and the birthday law is priced with the smaller pairwise probability 1/N, so the measured concentration can only help. Per-step cost in counted instructions: a 21921-instruction multiply step and a 13445-instruction squaring step, made of the dense Fp12 multiply 20000, a 1613-instruction twelve-key selector, a 48-instruction guard on the multiply channel, a 16-instruction column address, a 72-instruction table fetch, a 28-instruction label add, a 72-instruction key mix and the Granger-Scott cyclotomic squaring at its itemised 11632 (24 Fp multiplications plus 122 Fp additions). The squaring share is ONE number, the routing share f = 3/8, used for the step price, the step budget S and the success model; S is the least integer with S^2(1-f^2) >= 2*mu*N*ln(1/(1-0.392)) at mu = 11/10, giving log2 S = 125.810636; c_raw = 0.937125 and c_stress = 0.965333 with judgement-bounded fold rows repriced at 13/10, giving W_raw = 2^125.716950 and W_stress = 2^125.759734; the claim 125.7598 is the least four-decimal log2 value above log2(W_stress) + 2e-5. Success is Lambda = S^2(1-f^2)/(2*mu*N) = 0.4975803970, model success 0.3920000, carried with NO retention debit, against the 0.39 floor. Records are 112 bytes (48-byte class key plus two 32-byte exponent limbs) in one shared store. The report count is a CAP with a STATED SLACK: mean DP hits = ceil(S/2^80) = 61712849264585, cap = 2 x mean = 123425698529170 records, and every per-report row (record write, store lookup, drop-oldest drain) is charged AT THE CAP, so the bound holds on every run; the Chernoff row P(hits > cap) <= exp(-mean/3) = 2^-2.97e13 ships beside it and the census calibration (20240 records against a cap of 512 in 6400/6400 trials, evidence/t4-dp5.json) is a calibration, not the bound. Peak storage is 13823678355071904 bytes over store, labels, U labels, twelve-column advice, guard history, code and scratch. Auxiliary work is charged as GT tower arithmetic with ONE total in ONE file: a GT squaring is the counted cyclotomic row 11632 instructions = 0.58160 reference units, and a 381-bit exponentiation is 381 squarings plus 191 dense multiplies = 412.5896 reference units (the v15 documents printed 411.59, which is the same expression with 190, the MEAN Hamming weight, and is superseded); charged twice per trail start at the cap, giving 2^56.499 in total, which is 2^-69.26 of W_stress. Evidence is a real-tower toy with the same guarded step: an exhaustive census of all 9420 starts at the shipped depth D=12 comparing the FULL joint state (element, ring tuple) for 26 steps, with joint_min_lag null and zero joint returns while the element ladder of the same run has 12 returns all at lag 15, against the depth-0 control returning at lag 2 with 588 element returns and 24 two-cycles; a 256-start 400-step joint window with 156 repeats; a pattern census over every row pattern of length 2..6 at R=8 and R=64 with zero guarded returns in 706500 occurrences at R=64, now used only as a descriptive row; the corrected class-stream sweep over D in {12,24,48,128} at R = 64 and R = 1024 with CP-95 bounds; a measured class-frequency vector with chi-square and per-block split; 768/768 equivariance checks with zero splits, 0/384 coalescence splits against 349/384 for the control, 256/256 exact inverse pairs with 32/32 label-bit solves and 0/32 for the sign-flipped control, 144/144 end-to-end solves over all twelve shifts with one verified candidate each, and 24/24 checks on BLS12-381 itself including a real planted pairing instance. The density census (0.7316 at 2^-5, 0.5262 at 2^-7, every collision verified) is fixture-scale only. Success is conditional on three disclosed hypotheses: random-map walk quality within the carried 10 per cent allowance, pseudorandom routing and table fields, and ideal coins. No production run, no unconditional success theorem, no novelty claim and no practical break is claimed.
